service.semantics: Token overlap is native extend geometry at full-match/effective-prefix positions, not per-layer kernel work. Whole batch worker intervals are not allocated to gap tokens or interpreted as removable GPU time.

transfers.semantics: An anchor may cover other FULL nodes. Same-anchor later ACK is only an association, not per-component first-service reuse; unmatched D2H is not classified as wasted. Submit/ACK envelopes and transfer stream time are not measured scheduler CPU blocking or JCT savings.

context_prefix_reuse_evidence.semantics: Previously served same-session input-prefix loss, not newly appended input or a per-layer FULL/Mamba recomputation count.

host_block_eviction_attribution.full_reaccess_semantics: exact prefix match plus request device/host cached-token intervals; remaining evicted FULL interval is attributed to recomputation
host_block_eviction_attribution.identity_semantics: run-keyed HMAC over exact cache namespace and radix token prefix; raw token IDs are not written
host_block_eviction_attribution.mamba_reaccess_semantics: exact prefix revisit is observable, but native telemetry does not expose the Mamba hit location per node

scope: Complete-line prefixes are sealed independently; files are not atomic across streams.
Client metadata is read from client_24, not the historical helper's client_156 default.
FULL matches beyond an effective hybrid checkpoint are not automatically lost useful KV.
Whole prefill worker intervals are not exclusive GPU cost or removable JCT.
The live run's experimental sources and configuration are unchanged.
